podcast.body: During the final tour of Tom Petty's life, "American Girl" was performed as the concluding song of his sets. As Petty and the band played, a video screen displayed a diverse array of images of women, starting with a white woman and expanding to include African Americans, a Latina woman in a US military uniform, older women, middle-aged women, and transgender women. This performance, showcasing "actual American women," was the last significant act Petty presented to his fans before his passing, emphasizing an idea of evolution and broader thinking. "As he and the band played the song American Girl Images of all sorts of women flashed on a video screen."
